question: Which of the following plants is a parasite?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cuscuta.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cuscuta** is a **parasitic** plant.
 
• Since Cuscuta **does not have chlorophyll**, it **cannot synthesize** its own food by **photosynthesis**.
 
• It uses the **nutrients of host plants** for its growth.
 
• Other parasitic plants are - **Rafflesia, Viscum, Nuytsia floribunda**.
 
• Parasitic plants **cause damage to the host plant.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Mango**

 
 
• The scientific name of Mango is Mangifera Indica.
 
• It is a large fruit tree.
 
 
 
• **Pitcher plant **
 
 
• It belongs to carnivorous tree.
 
• It has the Ability to kill and digest insect.
 
• The leaves of the plants are converted to jug like pitcher.
 
 
 
• **Cactus**
 
 
• Cacti are **plants that have succulent stems, pads or branches with scales and spines instead of leaves**.
 
• Cactus pads are actually modified stems with a waxy coating.
